<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>KG Cinecraft | Wedding Post-Production Partner for Photographers, Filmmakers &amp; Studios</title>
<meta name="description" content="KG Cinecraft is a wedding post-production partner for photographers, filmmakers and studios. Highlight films, teasers, reels, cinematic and full wedding films, color grading, sound design and same-day edits, built on 10+ years of hands-on editing experience.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#FAF6F2">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:title" content="KG Cinecraft | Wedding Post-Production Partner">
<meta property="og:description" content="You focus on the shoot. We take care of the post-production.">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Crect width='64' height='64' rx='10' fill='%236D2A36'/%3E%3Ctext x='32' y='43' font-family='Georgia,serif' font-size='30' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23FAF6F2'%3EKG%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hanken+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600&family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "ProfessionalService",
  "name": "KG Cinecraft",
  "description": "Wedding post-production partner for photographers, filmmakers and studios.",
  "founder": { "@type": "Person", "name": "Kumar Kush" },
  "serviceType": ["Wedding post-production", "Wedding highlight films", "Color grading", "Sound design", "Same-day edit"]
}
</script>

<style>
:root{
  /* COLORS: change these values to re-theme the whole site */
  --porcelain:#FAF6F2;
  --white:#FFFDFB;
  --sand:#F0E7DE;
  --ink:#221B1A;
  --ink-soft:#5D5350;
  --wine:#6D2A36;
  --wine-deep:#4A1B25;
  --peach:#EDBB98;
  --dark:#231C1B;
  --on-dark:#F4EBE4;
  --muted-dark:#BBACA4;
  --line:rgba(34,27,26,.16);
  --line-dark:rgba(244,235,228,.2);
  --serif:'Instrument Serif','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Georgia,serif;
  --sans:'Hanken Grotesk',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --pad:clamp(20px,5vw,72px);
  --max:1240px;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){html{scroll-behavior:smooth}}
body{margin:0;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.65;color:var(--ink);background:var(--porcelain);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3,p,ol,ul,figure,dl,dd{margin:0}
ul,ol{padding:0;list-style:none}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--wine);outline-offset:3px}
.on-dark :focus-visible,.dark :focus-visible,.contact :focus-visible{outline-color:var(--peach)}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:8px;background:var(--wine);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;z-index:100;border-radius:3px}
.skip:focus{left:8px}

.wrap{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding-inline:max(var(--pad),env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)) max(var(--pad),env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.sec{padding-block:clamp(72px,10vw,128px);scroll-margin-top:64px}
.bg-porcelain{background:var(--porcelain)}
.bg-sand{background:var(--sand)}
.dark{background:var(--dark);color:var(--on-dark)}
.contact{background:var(--wine-deep);color:#fff}

.h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4.2vw,3.4rem);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.01em;max-width:20ch}
.lead-p{font-size:1.15rem;max-width:56ch}
.muted{color:var(--ink-soft)}
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);align-items:start}
.copy p+p{margin-top:20px}
.copy{max-width:58ch;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.copy strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}

.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;text-decoration:none;border:1.5px solid var(--wine);cursor:pointer;line-height:1.2;transition:background-color .2s,color .2s}
.btn-primary{background:var(--wine);color:#fff}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--wine-deep);border-color:var(--wine-deep)}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--wine)}
.btn-outline:hover{background:rgba(109,42,54,.08)}

/* Header */
.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(250,246,242,.93);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;min-height:66px}
.brand{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.6rem;letter-spacing:.04em;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
.site-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px}
.site-nav a{text-decoration:none;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--ink-soft);white-space:nowrap}
.site-nav a:hover{color:var(--wine)}
.site-nav .btn{color:#fff;padding:10px 18px;font-size:.92rem}
.site-nav .btn:hover{color:#fff}
.menu-btn{display:none;background:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.92rem}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding-block:clamp(48px,7vw,96px) clamp(64px,9vw,120px)}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:clamp(32px,5vw,80px);align-items:center}
.hero h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5vw,4.5rem);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:.07em}
.role{margin-top:20px;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:500;max-width:34ch;line-height:1.45}
.tagline{margin-top:28px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,2.4vw,2.05rem);line-height:1.22;color:var(--wine);max-width:24ch}
.hero .cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:38px}

.grade figcaption{margin-top:14px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.video-frame{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;border-radius:4px;background:#000;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(74,27,37,.22)}
.hero-video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.frame{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/10;overflow:hidden;border-radius:4px;touch-action:pan-y;cursor:ew-resize;--pos:50%;background:#000;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(74,27,37,.22)}
.frame .layer{position:absolute;inset:0}
.frame .layer svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.frame .raw{clip-path:inset(0 calc(100% - var(--pos)) 0 0);filter:saturate(.1) contrast(.55) brightness(1.2)}
.frame .raw::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(160,160,155,.28)}
.tag{position:absolute;top:14px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(34,27,26,.72);color:#fff;pointer-events:none}
.tag-l{left:14px}
.tag-r{right:14px;background:var(--wine)}
.tc{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:12px;font-size:.85rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.06em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6);pointer-events:none}
.handle{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:var(--pos);width:44px;margin-left:-22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;outline-offset:-4px}
.handle::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:50%;width:2px;margin-left:-1px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.handle span{position:relative;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:var(--wine);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.handle svg{width:22px;height:22px}

/* Why post-production matters */
.tasks{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.tasks li{padding:15px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:1.08rem}
.tasks-note{margin-top:26px;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:52ch}

/* How we help */
.helps-head{margin-bottom:56px}
.helps-head p{margin-top:22px}
.outcomes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 40px}
.outcomes li{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:26px}
.outcomes h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3vw,2.5rem);line-height:1.1;color:var(--wine)}
.outcomes p{margin-top:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:30ch}

/* Services */
.services-head{margin-bottom:48px}
.feature{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:clamp(24px,5vw,72px);background:var(--wine-deep);color:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:clamp(28px,4vw,52px);align-items:center;margin-bottom:56px}
.feature h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4vw,3.2rem);line-height:1.05}
.feature .flag{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:14px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--peach);color:var(--wine-deep)}
.feature p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);max-width:52ch}
.feature p+p{margin-top:14px}
.svc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:clamp(32px,6vw,88px);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.svc li{padding:26px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.svc h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:1.65rem;line-height:1.15}
.svc p{margin-top:6px;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:44ch}

/* Work */
.work-head{margin-bottom:48px}
.work-head p{margin-top:18px;color:var(--muted-dark);max-width:52ch}
.films{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:44px 28px;align-items:start}
.film{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.film.lead{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 2;align-self:stretch}
.thumb{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;background:#3A2C2A}
.film.lead .thumb{aspect-ratio:auto;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:260px}
.thumb img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.play{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:64px;height:64px;margin:-32px 0 0 -32px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(34,27,26,.7);border:1.5px solid #fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background-color .2s}
.play::before{content:"";margin-left:4px;border-left:16px solid #fff;border-top:10px solid transparent;border-bottom:10px solid transparent}
.thumb:hover .play{background:var(--wine)}
.p1{background:radial-gradient(circle at 72% 68%,rgba(255,220,160,.55),transparent 38%),linear-gradient(165deg,#3B2A3A,#8C4E5C 58%,#E0946A)}
.p2{background:radial-gradient(circle at 28% 70%,rgba(255,205,175,.5),transparent 40%),linear-gradient(170deg,#2E2A45,#7A4A62 55%,#D98A6A)}
.p3{background:radial-gradient(circle at 60% 75%,rgba(255,230,180,.5),transparent 40%),linear-gradient(160deg,#3A2A2E,#7A4B45 55%,#D9A46A)}
.film .label{margin-top:18px;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--peach);font-weight:600}
.film h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:1.75rem;line-height:1.15;margin-top:4px}
.film.lead h3{font-size:2.3rem}
.film-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 22px;margin-top:14px}
.watch{background:none;border:0;padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;color:#fff;border-bottom:2px solid var(--peach)}
.watch:hover{color:var(--peach)}
.yt{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted-dark);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
.yt:hover{color:#fff}

/* Player dialog */
dialog{padding:0;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:#000;width:min(1100px,94vw,calc(76vh * 16 / 9));max-width:none;max-height:none;overflow:visible}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(20,12,12,.88)}
.player-box{aspect-ratio:16/9;width:100%}
.player-box iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block}
.close{position:absolute;right:0;top:-44px;min-height:38px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:0;border-radius:3px;padding:8px 16px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}

/* Packages */
.packs-head{margin-bottom:52px}
.packs-head p{margin-top:20px}
.packs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px;align-items:stretch}
.pack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:clamp(26px,3vw,38px)}
.pack .level{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.bars{display:flex;gap:4px}
.bars i{width:22px;height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(34,27,26,.16)}
.bars i.on{background:var(--wine)}
.pack h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:2.5rem;line-height:1.05;margin-top:22px}
.pack .desc{margin-top:12px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.pack .focus{margin-top:auto;padding-top:28px}
.pack .focus b{display:block;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:10px}
.pack .focus ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.pack .focus li{font-size:.88rem;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.pack.cinema{background:var(--wine-deep);border-color:var(--wine-deep);color:#fff}
.pack.cinema .level,.pack.cinema .desc{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.pack.cinema .bars i{background:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
.pack.cinema .bars i.on{background:var(--peach)}
.pack.cinema .focus li{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.packs-note{margin-top:28px;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:60ch}

/* Approach */
.approach-head{margin-bottom:60px}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 32px}
.steps li{position:relative;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:30px}
.steps li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:-7px;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--wine);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--sand)}
.steps h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:1.7rem;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:10px}
.steps p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.97rem}

/* Why work with us */
.why-head{margin-bottom:48px}
.why{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.why li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,4fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:24px;padding:28px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:baseline}
.why h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:1.75rem;line-height:1.12}
.why p{color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:56ch}

/* Founder */
.founder{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,4fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);align-items:start}
.avatar{width:clamp(96px,12vw,140px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:var(--wine);color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4vw,3.2rem);display:grid;place-items:center}
.avatar-photo{width:clamp(96px,12vw,140px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 25%;border:3px solid var(--white);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(74,27,37,.18)}
.founder .name{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4vw,3.2rem);line-height:1.05;margin-top:22px}
.founder .role-line{margin-top:6px;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* Contact */
.contact-head p{margin-top:20px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-size:1.15rem;max-width:44ch}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,250px),1fr));gap:20px;margin-top:52px}
.tile{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:8px;padding:28px;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .2s}
.tile:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.tile small{font-size:.88rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.tile b{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:1.7rem;line-height:1.15}
.tile span{font-size:.98rem;color:var(--peach);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* Footer */
footer{background:var(--dark);color:var(--muted-dark);padding-block:44px;font-size:.92rem}
.foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 40px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.foot b{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--on-dark)}
.foot nav{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot a{text-decoration:none}
.foot a:hover{color:#fff}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width:1180px){
  .site-nav{gap:20px}
}
@media (max-width:1040px){
  .menu-btn{display:inline-block}
  .site-nav{display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:0;background:var(--porcelain);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px var(--pad) 22px;box-shadow:0 24px 40px rgba(34,27,26,.14);max-height:calc(100vh - 66px);overflow-y:auto}
  .site-header.open .site-nav{display:flex}
  .site-nav a{padding:12px 0;width:100%;font-size:1.05rem}
  .site-nav .btn{margin-top:10px;width:auto;padding:12px 20px}
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:48px 32px}
}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .split,.founder,.feature{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .films{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .film.lead{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:auto}
  .film.lead .thumb{aspect-ratio:16/9;min-height:0;flex:none}
  .packs{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .outcomes{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}
  .svc{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .why li{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .films{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .film.lead{grid-column:auto}
  .film.lead h3{font-size:1.9rem}
  .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
  .hero .cta .btn{flex:1 1 100%}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<a class="skip" href="#main">Skip to content</a>

<!-- Shared artwork for the before/after colour grade in the hero -->
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#1E3F55"/>
      <stop offset=".45" stop-color="#8C5A6B"/>
      <stop offset=".72" stop-color="#E8955A"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#F6C784"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sun">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFF3CF"/>
      <stop offset=".25" stop-color="#FBC16A" stop-opacity=".95"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#F08A4B" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="bokeh">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFE1A8" stop-opacity=".34"/>
      <stop offset=".7" stop-color="#FFD08A" stop-opacity=".16"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFD08A" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="bulb">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFF0C4"/>
      <stop offset=".35" stop-color="#FFD98A" stop-opacity=".7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFD98A" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <symbol id="scene" viewBox="0 0 1600 1000" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">
      <rect width="1600" height="1000" fill="url(#sky)"/>
      <circle cx="800" cy="650" r="300" fill="url(#sun)"/>
      <path d="M0 700 C200 650 380 690 560 660 C760 625 940 690 1150 655 C1330 625 1480 670 1600 650 V1000 H0Z" fill="#5B3F52"/>
      <path d="M0 780 C240 730 420 790 640 760 C900 725 1120 790 1340 752 C1450 735 1540 760 1600 750 V1000 H0Z" fill="#3A2B3A"/>
      <ellipse cx="170" cy="640" rx="86" ry="170" fill="#2A2030"/>
      <ellipse cx="300" cy="690" rx="60" ry="120" fill="#2F2435"/>
      <ellipse cx="1440" cy="630" rx="92" ry="180" fill="#2A2030"/>
      <ellipse cx="1310" cy="690" rx="58" ry="118" fill="#2F2435"/>
      <path d="M0 850 C400 815 1200 815 1600 850 V1000 H0Z" fill="#1F1519"/>
      <!-- floral arch -->
      <path d="M560 870 V520 A240 240 0 0 1 1040 520 V870" fill="none" stroke="#2A1E27" stroke-width="14"/>
      <path d="M560 870 V520 A240 240 0 0 1 1040 520 V870" fill="none" stroke="#3E5B45" stroke-width="22" stroke-dasharray="20 9" opacity=".85"/>
      <path d="M560 870 V520 A240 240 0 0 1 1040 520 V870" fill="none" stroke="#E9A7A0" stroke-width="26" stroke-dasharray="1 30" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M560 870 V520 A240 240 0 0 1 1040 520 V870" fill="none" stroke="#F6DDB6" stroke-width="16" stroke-dasharray="1 46" stroke-dashoffset="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <!-- couple -->

<dialog id="player" aria-label="Film player">
  <button class="close" type="button" id="close-player">Close</button>
  <div class="player-box" id="player-box"></div>
</dialog>

<script>
/* ==========================================================
   EDIT THIS BLOCK: your portfolio videos and contact details
   ----------------------------------------------------------
   Each entry needs a YouTube link in "url" — used exactly as given, for
   both the video player and the "Open on YouTube" link. If you'd rather
   show a real title than "Selected Work 0X", change "label" to the title.
   ========================================================== */
const FILMS = [
  { label: "Jaipur documentary style wedding highlights TSL", url: "https://youtu.be/ulRmH7f_ENw" },
  { label: "New Delhi natural pre-wed",                       url: "https://youtu.be/GXYtD6aduE0" },
  { label: "Nayan & Sarupal wedding highlight",                url: "https://youtu.be/zpg-1RWNbm4" },
  { label: "Rashi & Nipun wedding trailer",                    url: "https://youtu.be/ZwU0QMKu1aE" },
  { label: "Same day edit - trailer",                          url: "https://youtu.be/NcIgNpOlQfA" },
  { label: "The groom teaser",                                 url: "https://youtu.be/oh4cH6rUBiE" },
  { label: "Italian wedding teaser",                            url: "https://youtu.be/iG-J5XwypW0" }
];

const SITE = {
  whatsappUrl: "https://shorturl.at/czjXe",
  phoneDisplay: "7217699165",   // shown on the page
  phoneDial: "+917217699165",   // used by the Call button (country code added so it works from anywhere)
  email: "kushtheeditor@gmail.com"
};
/* ========================================================== */

(function () {
  const $ = (s, r) => (r || document).querySelector(s);
  const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
  $("#yr").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

  /* Contact options: show a real link when available, otherwise a clearly marked placeholder that does nothing when clicked */
  const wa = $("#t-wa");
  if (SITE.whatsappUrl) { wa.href = SITE.whatsappUrl; wa.target = "_blank"; wa.rel = "noopener"; }
  else { wa.removeAttribute("href"); wa.querySelector("b").textContent = "[Add WhatsApp Link]"; }

  const mail = $("#t-mail");
  if (SITE.email) { mail.href = "mailto:" + SITE.email; }
  else { mail.removeAttribute("href"); $("#t-mail-label").textContent = "[Add Email Address]"; }

  const call = $("#t-call");
  if (SITE.phoneDial) { call.href = "tel:" + SITE.phoneDial; $("#t-num").textContent = SITE.phoneDisplay; }
  else { call.removeAttribute("href"); call.querySelector("b").textContent = "[Add Contact Number]"; }

  /* Mobile menu */
  const header = $(".site-header"), menuBtn = $(".menu-btn");
  menuBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const open = header.classList.toggle("open");
    menuBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".site-nav a").forEach(a => a.addEventListener("click", () => {
    header.classList.remove("open"); menuBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
  }));

  /* YouTube helper */
  const YT = /(?:youtu\.be\/|youtube(?:-nocookie)?\.com\/(?:watch\?(?:.*&)?v=|embed\/|shorts\/|live\/|v\/))([\w-]{11})/;
  function ytId(u) { const m = String(u || "").match(YT); return m ? m[1] : null; }

  /* Projects */
  const grid = $("#films");
  grid.innerHTML = FILMS.map((f, i) => {
    const id = ytId(f.url), poster = "p" + ((i % 3) + 1);
    const thumb = id
      ? '<button class="thumb ' + poster + '" type="button" data-id="' + id + '" aria-label="Watch Film: ' + esc(f.label) + '">' +
        '<img src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/' + id + '/hqdefault.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="this.remove()"><span class="play"></span></button>'
      : '<div class="thumb ' + poster + '"></div>';
    const actions = id
      ? '<div class="film-actions"><button class="watch" type="button" data-id="' + id + '">Watch Film →</button>' +
        '<a class="yt" href="' + esc(f.url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open on YouTube</a></div>'
      : "";
    return '<article class="film' + (i === 0 ? " lead" : "") + '">' + thumb +
      "<h3>" + esc(f.label) + "</h3>" + actions + "</article>";
  }).join("");

  /* Video player */
  const dlg = $("#player"), box = $("#player-box");
  grid.addEventListener("click", e => {
    const b = e.target.closest("[data-id]"); if (!b) return;
    box.innerHTML = '<iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/' + b.dataset.id +
      '?autoplay=1&rel=0&modestbranding=1" title="Wedding film" allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; fullscreen" allowfullscreen></iframe>';
    dlg.showModal();
  });
  function closePlayer() { dlg.close(); }
  dlg.addEventListener("close", () => { box.innerHTML = ""; });
  $("#close-player").addEventListener("click", closePlayer);
  dlg.addEventListener("click", e => { if (e.target === dlg) closePlayer(); });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
